scope: Primary SAP evidence for cross-functional logistics and finance analytics
policy: SAP sources verify available analytics capabilities, events and product terminology. Lab KPI formulas, ownership rules, decompositions and targets are independently authored unless a source explicitly defines the metric.

sources.title: S/4HANA Embedded Analytics
sources.evidence_role: Supports operational analytics on S/4HANA transactional data through CDS-based analytical content and insight-to-action navigation.

sources.title: Custom Analytical Queries
sources.evidence_role: Supports governed multidimensional analytical queries over CDS data and consumption in SAP Analytics Cloud.

sources.title: Procurement Analytics
sources.evidence_role: Supports real-time procurement reporting, monitoring and purchasing analytics.

sources.title: Overall Supplier Evaluation
sources.evidence_role: Supports supplier performance analysis using operational criteria including price, quantity, quality and time.

sources.title: Analytics in PP/DS
sources.evidence_role: Supports analytics for resources, procurement, production orders, operations and pegging with status, duration, quantity and date/time information.

sources.title: Warehouse KPIs - Operations
sources.evidence_role: Supports operational EWM KPI monitoring for overdue outbound items, picking tasks, blocks and goods issue status.

sources.title: Freight Order Execution Monitoring
sources.evidence_role: Supports transportation execution KPIs, critical statuses and carrier on-time performance.

sources.title: Overdue Receivables
sources.evidence_role: Defines the overdue receivables KPI as overdue receivable amount divided by total open receivable amount and supports drill-down by customer, company code, clerk, country and region.

sources.title: Process Flows and Performance Indicators
sources.evidence_role: Supports end-to-end process analysis using progress, automation, backlog, exceptions and execution behavior.
